notes: Chapter starts at absolute zero and limits productive scope to greeting, name exchange, meeting response and parting.
Ich heiße ... and Wie heißt du? are taught as contextual chunks before broader conjugation.
Freut mich is taught as a chunk rather than by misleading token translation.
Reading contains target-language text with information-retrieval questions.
Pronunciation targets word-initial h and short-question intonation; STT is not treated as pronunciation scoring.
